title: Postfix Calculation Engine
description: You are tasked with writing an arithmetic expression evaluator for a retro calculator that processes expressions written in Reverse Polish Notation (Postfix notation). Each token is an integer or an arithmetic operator (+, -, *, /). Division between integers should truncate toward zero.
constraints: tokens[i] is either an operator: "+", "-", "*", "/", or an integer in the range [-200, 200].
input_format: An array of strings representing tokens in Reverse Polish Notation.
output_format: An integer representing the final evaluation result.
